blocks.content: Quiz: What is the callback queue mainly used for?
Tap an option below to answer:
Variables live in memory and scope, not in queues. The callback queue is unrelated to variable storage.
Variables live in memory and scope, not in queues. The callback queue is unrelated to variable storage.
Only the call stack executes code. The callback queue never runs functions directly.
Only the call stack executes code. The callback queue never runs functions directly.
To hold asynchronous callbacks waiting for the call stack to be empty.
Asynchronous callbacks wait here until JavaScript finishes the current work and the call stack becomes free.
Asynchronous callbacks wait here until JavaScript finishes the current work and the call stack becomes free.
The call stack is always required. The callback queue works alongside it, not instead of it.
